description: This is an Android activity class named ContentInfoActivity that displays detailed information about a selected content item, including an image poster, title, description, and a 'Watch now' button. It fetches content details and playback URLs from a remote server via HTTP requests, loads images asynchronously, and handles user interactions to initiate media playback.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that displays content info and handles user interaction for playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the poster image, sets up UI components, and initiates fetching of content info based on intent extras.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed content info from the server and updates the UI with the retrieved title and description.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles the 'Watch now' button click, fetches playback URL from server, and starts the media player activity.
